ratings_why.fun: Every turn is a real choice of which Lids are fuel and which are savings, and Weaver, Tapwell, Doorward and the two Masters chain in ways worth hunting; a few plain cards hold it under 8.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because the whole tribe changes board geometry: front-row Lids don't count, so enemies are sent into your back row, and scouts see doors marked with Knocks instead of units; no current tribe hides the board you fight with.

verdict_why: Two rules can't be read yet (whose stats Corkhinge buffs, and whether a Spring stops the knocker's attack); the rest is ready.

points.text: Signora Corkhinge's "it gains +4/+4" reads as Corkhinge growing, but the builds mean the springing unit. Say "that unit gains +4/+4".
For an attack Knock, say whether the Spring lands before the enemy's attack and whether a knocker killed by the Spring still attacks. Slit-Mender and the trapdoor front row depend on it.
Gossamer Jill fills every empty slot, so Pardo's Nieces and other summons have nowhere to go. That tension is a good decision; say where those summons go, for example Underneath.
The Usher putting a Lid on another tribe's unit makes it Patient fuel for Mabyn and Diadem, a great off-label use. Letting the Usher pick the Knock (beside or across) would add a placement puzzle.
Ballot Clerk is the one card that touches nothing else. Paying on Patient units or on Lids opened would make both builds want it.

standouts.why: Its Knock is another Lid opening, so it turns Tapwell, Doorward and default-rule openings into chains.
Re-closing a Lid after its Spring is a multiplier with board-wide reach: Slit-Mender, Pardo and Tapwell all want it.
Fills empty slots with Lids that scale with Patience and feed the Spring count, so it bridges both builds.

weakest.why: Plain conditional gold with no hook into Lids or Springs.
A vanilla across-Knock body; fine as tempo, nothing to combo.
Same Patient seed as Diadem and Mabyn, only smaller.

flags.note: "It" could be Corkhinge or the springing unit.
Re-closing after each Spring, with stacking +3 Attack and Doorward support, can stab one attacker every cycle.
With The Past Master, every Sprung unit Springs twice more, Pardo's Nieces included; bounded by slots, but a big swing.
Grows with the square of Patient units, and Usher and Jill add more Lids; a win streak snowballs.
